servicesSummary: Embassy of the State of Qatar Registrant provides government and public relations services for Qatar with regard to bilateral issues pertaining to the relationship between Qatar and the united states. Such services include outreach to the united states Congress, the federal government, and the media. Registrant has also maintained ongoing coordination with the Medal of Honor Museum and the Washingtonian Magazine with regard to Qatar’s partnerships and events.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $1,902.91 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
